# Analytics tools

Delivery, engagement, failures, spend and account health across WhatsApp, SMS and RCS.

**OAuth scope:** `analytics:read` · **Tools:** 7 callable · **Approx. context cost:** ~1.6k tokens

| Tool | What it does | Action |
|---|---|---|
| [`get_performance`](#get_performance) | Delivery and engagement KPIs across WhatsApp, SMS and RCS, optionally by template and compared with the previous period. | Read-only |
| [`get_failures`](#get_failures) | Why messages failed, ranked by lost volume, with a plain-English cause and suggested fix for each. | Read-only |
| [`get_template_detail`](#get_template_detail) | Deep dive into one template: daily trend, button clicks and errors. | Read-only |
| [`get_campaigns`](#get_campaigns) | WhatsApp campaign results ranked by impact, or one campaign's day-by-day detail. | Read-only |
| [`get_spend`](#get_spend) | Where your messaging volume goes, by billing bucket and channel. | Read-only |
| [`get_account_health`](#get_account_health) | Per-channel account status: connection, identity, billing type and active senders. | Read-only |
| [`get_report`](#get_report) | Raw rows from a named report, paginated, for when you need the exact underlying data. | Read-only |

## `get_performance`

Delivery and engagement KPIs across WhatsApp, SMS and RCS, optionally by template and compared with the previous period.

**Action:** Read-only · **Channels:** WhatsApp, SMS, RCS

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `start_date` **(required)** | `string` | Window start, YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `end_date` **(required)** | `string` | Window end (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `channels` | `string`[] | Subset of: whatsapp, sms, rcs. Omit for every connected channel. |
| `group_by` | `string` | One of: channel, sender, template, country, day, category. Default channel. |
| `compare_to_previous` | `boolean` | Also fetch the preceding window of equal length and add deltas. |

<details><summary>Model-facing description</summary>

Delivery and engagement KPIs across channels: the starting point for any
"how is my messaging / WhatsApp / SMS / RCS doing" question.
group_by="template" ranks all templates; for ONE named template prefer get_template_detail.

</details>

## `get_failures`

Why messages failed, ranked by lost volume, with a plain-English cause and suggested fix for each.

**Action:** Read-only · **Channels:** WhatsApp, SMS, RCS

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `start_date` **(required)** | `string` | Window start, YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `end_date` **(required)** | `string` | Window end (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `channels` | `string`[] | Subset of: whatsapp, sms, rcs. Omit for every connected channel. |
| `limit` | `integer` | Maximum breakdown rows returned. |

<details><summary>Model-facing description</summary>

Why messages did not land: failure reasons ranked by lost volume, each with
a plain-English cause and a suggested fix. Prefer this over get_performance
when the question is about errors, drops, or undelivered messages.

</details>

## `get_template_detail`

Deep dive into one template: daily trend, button clicks and errors.

**Action:** Read-only · **Channels:** WhatsApp, SMS, RCS

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `template` **(required)** | `string` | Exact template name to inspect. |
| `start_date` **(required)** | `string` | Window start, YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `end_date` **(required)** | `string` | Window end (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `channels` | `string`[] | Subset of: whatsapp, sms, rcs. Omit for every connected channel. |

<details><summary>Model-facing description</summary>

Deep dive into ONE named template: daily trend, button clicks, and its
genuine errors. To rank or compare templates use get_performance with
group_by="template" instead.

</details>

## `get_campaigns`

WhatsApp campaign results ranked by impact, or one campaign's day-by-day detail.

**Action:** Read-only · **Channels:** WhatsApp

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `start_date` **(required)** | `string` | Window start, YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `end_date` **(required)** | `string` | Window end (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `campaign_id` | `string` | Campaign id from the ranked list, for a single campaign's per-day detail. Omit for the ranked list. |
| `limit` | `integer` | Maximum breakdown rows returned. |

<details><summary>Model-facing description</summary>

How campaigns performed: the window's WhatsApp campaigns ranked by impact,
or one campaign's per-day detail when campaign_id is given. WhatsApp only.
Counts settle at t+1 — today's numbers are provisional until tomorrow.

</details>

## `get_spend`

Where your messaging volume goes, by billing bucket and channel.

**Action:** Read-only · **Channels:** WhatsApp, SMS, RCS

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `start_date` **(required)** | `string` | Window start, YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `end_date` **(required)** | `string` | Window end (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `channels` | `string`[] | Subset of: whatsapp, sms, rcs. Omit for every connected channel. |
| `compare_to_previous` | `boolean` | Also fetch the preceding window of equal length and add deltas. |

<details><summary>Model-facing description</summary>

Where messaging volume concentrates by billing bucket, per channel.
Upstream carries no prices for this account, so money metrics are null with
the reason in coverage — never estimate costs from this.

</details>

## `get_account_health`

Per-channel account status: connection, identity, billing type and active senders.

**Action:** Read-only · **Channels:** WhatsApp, SMS, RCS

_No parameters._

<details><summary>Model-facing description</summary>

Who this account is on each channel: connection status, per-channel
identity, billing type, and active senders. Call it for account-setup
questions or to see why a channel has no data.

</details>

## `get_report`

Raw rows from a named report, paginated, for when you need the exact underlying data.

**Action:** Read-only · **Channels:** WhatsApp, SMS, RCS

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `report` **(required)** | `string` | One of: rcs_bot_analytics, sms_delivery, sms_dlt_template, sms_errors, sms_latency, sms_usage_stats, whatsapp_billing, whatsapp_button_summary, whatsapp_campaigns, whatsapp_errors, whatsapp_messages, whatsapp_requests, whatsapp_template_daily, whatsapp_template_engagement, whatsapp_template_errors, whatsapp_waba_account_mapping, whatsapp_waba_agentic_billing, whatsapp_waba_billing, whatsapp_waba_errors, whatsapp_waba_mau, whatsapp_waba_messages, whatsapp_waba_template_engagement. |
| `start_date` **(required)** | `string` | Window start, YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `end_date` **(required)** | `string` | Window end (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `page` | `integer` | Page number, from 1. |
| `page_size` | `integer` | Rows per page (max 500). |
| `filters` | `object` | Report parameters (campaign_id, waba_number, month, year, mobile_number, template_name, language); any other key is an exact-match row filter. |

<details><summary>Model-facing description</summary>

Raw-row escape hatch: one page of unprocessed rows from a named legacy
report, always paginated. Prefer the other six tools for any analytical
question; use this only when the exact upstream rows are required.

</details>
